title: Password Purge
subject: Locked out after password reset — MFA chaos

ring.caption: *ring ring* — Floor 2 inbound
ring.intro: Hi, this is Morgan from Marketing. I reset my password like the portal told me to, and now I'm locked out of everything — including the portal. Also my phone keeps asking for a code from an app I deleted in 2019. Help?

name_check.hint: Caller name is on the ticket. Type it exactly (spelling counts — QA is watching).
name_check.wrong_reply: Uh… that's not me. Did you pull up the wrong ticket? I'm Morgan. With a G.
name_check.correct_reply: Yes! Morgan Ellery. Thank you for actually reading the ticket.

diagnose.prompt: Morgan is locked out after a self-service reset and MFA is pointing at a dead authenticator. What's the root cause?

choices.text: Stale MFA method — reset landed, but authenticator still targets an old device.
choices.reply: That tracks. Password is new; the six-digit ghost is the old phone. Classic.

choices.text: Broken keyboard — Caps Lock is gaslighting them again.
choices.reply: I checked Caps Lock. Twice. The keys work. My dignity does not.

resolve.prompt: Close it clean. Check the steps in order — QA grades sequence.

steps.text: Force a controlled password reset in Northwave AD
Register / confirm MFA on the current authenticator app
Have Morgan verify login to email + portal

resolve.success_reply: I'm in. The portal loves me again. Marketing may yet survive Q4.
resolve.partial_reply: Something's still weird on my end. Can you walk the checklist again?

grade_roast.A: Lead: Textbook desk work. Morgan might send you a fruit basket. Or a Slack react. Same thing.
grade_roast.B: Lead: Solid close. MFA ghosts vanquished. Coffee earned.
grade_roast.C: Lead: Ticket closed. Barely. QA muttered but signed off.
grade_roast.D: Lead: It works, somehow. Please reread the MFA runbook.
grade_roast.F: Lead: We reopened it. Morgan is calling back. Bring snacks.
